expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Reports whether the display string is empty. Reports whether the display string is empty or whitespace. Reports whether the text is transient. Reports whether localization leaves the text unchanged. Reports whether the text originated from a string. Reports whether the text references a string table. Extracts named placeholders. @param ParameterNames Receives parameter names in the pattern.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Record every out/inout value before and after the call and verify writeback. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Known positive and negative receiver states, empty/default state, exact lookup keys, and boundary values implied by the listed signatures.
testScope: bool Text.IsEmpty() const; | bool Text.IsEmptyOrWhitespace() const; | bool Text.IsTransient() const; | bool Text.IsCultureInvariant() const; | bool Text.IsInitializedFromString() const; | bool Text.IsFromStringTable() const; | void FText::GetFormatPatternParameters(const FText& Fmt, TArray<FString>&out ParameterNames);
